source: docs/design/33-crypto.md, Testing: published vectors for the crypto backends. NIST/GCM spec (AES-256-GCM), RFC 5869 (HKDF), RFC 8032 (Ed25519), RFC 7748 (X25519), RFC 6979 A.2.5 (P-256 key and signature), the CFRG's RFC 9180 test-vectors.json (HPKE base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, AES-128-GCM and AES-256-GCM), and a Wycheproof subset (testvectors_v1, 0.9rc5): AES-GCM with 256-bit keys and 96-bit nonces, X25519 valid and low-order cases, Ed25519 valid and invalid, ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 P1363 (40 valid, every invalid), HKDF-SHA256 (40).
